summary: Full E2E verification of Org self-registration + admin approval flow. Backend: 6/6 pytest passing in test_org_register.py (register creates pending, admin approval makes public, duplicate owner/tag blocked, validation, unauth). Frontend: All acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright — CTA card + Register button visible for RSI-verified user w/ no org, modal opens with all documented fields, client-side validation shows inline error 'Name must be 3–64 characters' for short name/tag without hitting backend, valid submission shows success state '✓ APPLICATION SUBMITTED — awaiting admin approval', modal auto-closes, MyOrgPanel appears with '⏳ PENDING REVIEW' badge, CTA is hidden post-registration, pending org excluded from GET /api/orgs, GET /api/user/my-org returns approval_status='pending' + self_registered=true, admin POST /api/admin/orgs/{id}/approve → org appears on public list, admin DELETE /api/admin/orgs/{id} cleans up. critical_code_review_comments: Organizations.jsx (~980 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting RegisterOrgModal and MyOrgPanel into their own files.
RegisterOrgModal success auto-closes after only 1400ms (Organizations.jsx:701) — barely long enough for the user to read the confirmation. Consider 2000-2500ms or dismiss-on-click.
Client-side validation only surfaces the FIRST failing rule (e.g. short name masks short tag). Minor UX polish — could show both errors.
